comment: Host -> reservation-catalog map for the HITL fleet inventory (gen_inventory.py). This is the ONE piece the reservation catalogs can't carry: catalog.json is fleet-identical and discovery-based (it never names hitl-rig-1/2/3), and amd-rig runs TWO daemons off two catalogs — so the host<->catalog binding lives here, alongside each host's board and role. It mirrors the //pi/hitl:BUILD sbc_application targets (hitl / hitl_pi3 -> catalog.json, hitl_sdr -> catalog-sdr.json + catalog-phone.json, the darwin runner -> catalog-mac.json) and the deployed --hostname values (see hitl_station_config.md). Update this when a rig is added/retired or re-boarded.

hosts.role: Pi rig (auto-discovered; DUT 2 is an ESP32-C3, per catalog.json chip_overrides)
SDR RE bench (composite C6+HackRF) + Android phone bench (two daemons)
